It is alleged in the FIR that the accused applicant at the relevant time was working as District Minority Welfare Officer, Meerut and towards distribution of scholarship Rs.17 lacs were sanctioned to be distributed as scholarship to several Schools and Madarsas but however the said amount was not distributed and forged account numbers were sent to the Government.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: The bank account numbers were also manipulated and accordingly the Principal and Managers of the concerned schools did not distribute it amongst the students eligible for the scholarship.

sentences.text:
In Sushila Aggarwal and others vs.
State (NCT of Delhi) and another, (2020) 5 SCC 1, the Hon'ble Apex Court has settled the controversy finally by holding the anticipatory bail need not be of limited duration invariably.

State (NCT of Delhi) and another, (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: In appropriate case, it can continue upto conclusion of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 7. It has been further held therein that anticipatory bail granted can, depending on the conduct and behavior of the accused, continue after filing of the charge sheet till end of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 8. It has been further held by the Hon'ble Apex Court that while considering an application for grant of anticipatory bail, the court has to consider the nature of the offence, the role of the person, the likelihood of his influencing the course of investigation, or tampering with evidence including intimidating witnesses, llikelihood of fleeing justice, such as leaving the country, etc.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: It has further been held that Courts ought to be generally guided by considerations such as the nature and gravity of the offences, the role attributed to the applicant, and the facts of the case, while considering whether to grant anticipatory bail, or refuse it.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Whether to grant or not is a matter of discretion.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 9. In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court, I deem it not a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the present applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Prayer made in the application is refused.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 10. The anticipatory bail application is rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Suman Gautam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2023.json

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.93 of 2016,
under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B I.P.C. and Section 13(1)(c) of Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station Kithore, District Meerut with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicant may be released on bail.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
The applicant was working as Social Welfare Officer and as per prosecution version, while being posted as Social Welfare Officer, district Meerut, she has transferred the public funds of Rs.6,84,000/- to Maulana Azad Inter College, Laliyana, Meerut for scholarship of scheduled castes and scheduled tribes students but the said funds were misused in conspiracy with manager of said college and others and the same were not paid to the eligible students.
Learned counsel submitted that as a Social Welfare Officer, the applicant has transferred the said funds in the account of the said college and that the duty of disbursement of amount to the eligible students was of college authorities and as per version of college authorities, the said scholarship amount were paid to the eligible students in cash.
It has been stated that in case, the applicant is granted anticipatory bail, she shall not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate during investigation and would obey all conditions of bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has strongly opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail and submitted that applicant, while working as Social Welfare Officer, has transferred an amount of Rs.6,84000/- to the above referred college and that the said public funds were misused and were not paid to the eligible students.
It is further submitted that the applicant is not co-operating during investigation and she is continuously absent from her duty and evading investigation and that there is criminal history of 98 cases against applicant.
opennyai_summary.final__decision: Hence the present application for anticipatory bail is hereby rejected.
